note: Interaction kinds. Data, not code - docs/dnd/03-KNOWLEDGE-BASE.md S7. One kind is one thing a person can do to another: how big it is (`magnitude`, before anyone's circumstances apply), how it moves the two of them (`deltas`, written from the point of view of the person it happened TO - debt is positive when they owe the other), how it reads in a memory (`phrase`), and which optional need it belongs to if any (`requires`). Replaces four separate Python tables that had already drifted apart.

interactions.label: Attacked
interactions.description: Violence done to them.

interactions.label: Bested
interactions.description: Beat them at something. They think more of you and like you less.

interactions.label: Betrayed
interactions.description: Trust used against them. The one act meant to be decisive.

interactions.label: Courted
interactions.description: Interest, plainly meant.

interactions.label: Flirted
interactions.description: Interest, lightly shown.

interactions.label: Gave a gift
interactions.description: Something given, freely.

interactions.label: Healed
interactions.description: Hurt undone.

interactions.label: Helped
interactions.description: A hand when it was needed. Small, and it puts them in your debt.

interactions.label: Insulted
interactions.description: Said ill of them, to their face or where it got back.

interactions.label: Kept their word
interactions.description: Did what they said they would. Moves trust rather than warmth.

interactions.label: Lay with
interactions.description: The night together.

interactions.label: Lied to
interactions.description: Told them something untrue. Only trust moves — they may never know why.

interactions.label: Met
interactions.description: Two people who did not know each other now do, barely.

interactions.label: Praised
interactions.description: Said well of them, and meant it.

interactions.label: Stepped in front of them
interactions.description: Put themselves in the way of something coming at you. Lighter than being saved outright - the danger was taken on, not necessarily taken away - but it is the same kind of debt.

interactions.label: Turned down
interactions.description: Turned down. Costs wanting far more than it costs warmth.

interactions.label: Repelled
interactions.description: Not a courtship that failed — somebody who turns your stomach. Bleeds into how you see them the more you see of them.

interactions.label: Saved their life
interactions.description: They would not have come out of it alone. The heaviest good thing one person does for another.

interactions.label: Stole from
interactions.description: Took what was theirs.

interactions.label: Talked
interactions.description: A conversation. The smallest thing that counts as anything.

interactions.label: Threatened
interactions.description: Violence promised. Buys fear and a little respect, and costs warmth.

interactions.label: Travelled with
interactions.description: Time on the road together, which closes distance faster than talk.
